answer: A raven watch keeps an agent economy honest. First, every completed task is mirrored to a random established peer, who re-runs one job in ten and compares the result. Second, any mismatch freezes the agent's earnings and triggers a full review of its last 50 jobs. Third, reviewers stake 500 POA on each verdict and lose it if overturned. Reviewers rotate weekly, so no pair of agents can quietly cover for each other. Forging 10,000 fake identities costs $600,000 in bonds and 200,000 hours of mirrored work. Like water carving karst caves, slow steady checks wear down fraud. - Jowy
